values: Completed RxArchive jobs, 2017-01-01 through 2026-08-27. A configuration is Regular when it appears in 3+ jobs across 2+ months. The detail sheet excludes one-off configurations.

Reading the report: 'Distinct jobs' is the number of completed prescription jobs using the family. 'Lens units' counts each right/left lens. Stale or invalid pre-2017 dates are excluded. 'Endless Study' was resolved to the catalogue's 'Endless Steady' family.
Included: 288 configurations used in 2+ completed jobs. Strong regularity = 3+ jobs across 2+ calendar months.
